summary: Executed full backend+frontend regression for Upstox/readability/provider-routing scope on public preview. Backend suites passed after updating outdated settlement fixture boundary; frontend flow largely stable but mobile touch target sizing and rupee metric text overflow remain.

minor.issue: PendingDeprecationWarning from starlette multipart import path (non-blocking).

ui_bugs.issue: Tap targets are below recommended 44px minimum (mobile menu ~30x38, kill-switch ~38x38), reducing touch accessibility.
Rupee value text container overflows within equity metric element on 390x844 check.

issues: Touch target sizing is inconsistent with accessibility baseline for primary controls.
Numeric metric typography still clips/overflows at element level for ₹10,00,000.00.

action_items: Increase mobile topbar interactive targets to >=44x44 for menu and kill switch buttons.
Adjust mobile metric-value typography/layout so INR values never overflow their metric cell.
Retest mobile dashboard at 390x844 after CSS updates.
Optional: clean up starlette/python_multipart deprecation warning in test runtime.
critical_code_review_comments: Regression fixture mismatch was real: settlement tests must patch research.market_provider (new routing boundary), not direct FyersMarketDataProvider wiring.
Upstox OAuth gate correctly stays fail-closed when permanent BROKER_PUBLIC_ORIGIN is not configured (returns 409, no fabricated callback host exposed).
Connection status responses continue masking encrypted payloads; configured_fields exposed without secret values (expected).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (major route/navigation/provider UI flows passed; 2 mobile readability/accessibility defects)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable example.com users via public /api/auth/register during automated API tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used: https://no-login-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Desktop route/readability checks passed including sidebar labs collapse/search discoverability, Upstox IDs, pending OAuth gate, and PNG logo download. Mobile drawer open/close and route navigation passed with no page-level horizontal overflow. Reproduce open defects by checking control bounding boxes for mobile-menu-button/kill-switch-button and equity metric-value overflow at 390x844.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: mobile control sizes are explicitly constrained in readability.css under @media(max-width:767px): .mobile-menu width:30px;height:38px and .topbar-actions>.kill-button min-height/min-width 38px, yielding touch targets below accessibility baseline. RCA-2: large tabular numeric metric text (₹10,00,000.00) in constrained mobile metric cards can exceed available content width; automation flagged element-level overflow even when document-level overflow is absent.
